documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our field services team struggles with missed handoffs. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer explicitly states that their field services team struggles with 'missed handoffs' and they want 'workflow coordination and account reporting.' They have requested a discovery meeting to clarify their requirements but have not yet approved a budget. The current stage is 'qualified' with consent granted, and no blocking prerequisites are in place.

claims.quote: Our field services team struggles with missed handoffs.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your field services team is currently struggling with missed handoffs, and you are looking for workflow coordination and account reporting to address this challenge. A discovery meeting would be a great next step to better understand your specific requirements and how Cedar Systems can support your needs. We are happy to schedule this at your convenience.
questions: What specific types of handoffs are being missed in your field services workflow?
Are there any existing tools or systems currently used for workflow coordination or account reporting that you would like to integrate with?
uncertainties: The customer has not yet approved a budget, which may impact the scope or timeline of the project.
